jurisdiction.name: Timor-Leste
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Timor-Leste has no national AI law, AI strategy, AI guidance or data protection law. The Timor Digital 2032 plan (approved in 2023) does not mention AI; AI appears only in government press releases, such as an August 2026 government dialogue on AI and a September 2026 Council of Ministers decision endorsing strategic use of AI for the 2029 ASEAN chairmanship, and as an emerging-technology pillar in a draft Digital Transformation Strategy 2026-2036 that has not been published.
lead_institutions: Presidency of the Council of Ministers
narrative.review_notes: This review was completed on 12 October 2026 and covers national law, government, ministries and regulators. Official sources were searched and no national AI governance documents were found; the draft digital transformation strategy and recent cabinet decisions are listed as leads.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Timor-Leste's official gazette, the government portal, the Timor Digital 2032 plan, ministries and regulators were searched in Portuguese and English. No qualifying AI-governance document was found in any category; government announcements on AI are listed as leads until a document is published. The gazette has no full-text search, so individual issues have not yet been searched one by one.
coverage_audit.technical_note: Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. Timor Digital 2032 (PT and EN) and Government Resolution No. 4/2023 read in full: no AI reference, so not recorded. Despacho 11/PM/VIII/2026 read: no AI. Jornal da República has no full-text search (no bulk search); tic.gov.tl Strategic Plan page reset; no separate Tetum search. Not a party to Convention 108. Units covered: Law: Searched, nothing found. No AI law or AI provisions found. Jornal da República Série II n.º 31-A/2026 (Despacho n.º 11/PM/VIII/2026 creating the Interministerial Commission on Cybersecurity and Digitalisation) read in full: covers cybersecurity, cyberspace, data protection and cybercrime regulation but does not mention AI. Resolução do Governo n.º 4/2023 (Série I n.º 5) read: approves Timor Digital 2032, no AI content. No data protection law in force (constitutional art. 38 only); a cyber legislative-authorisation bill went to Parliament on 31 July 2026 (not AI-specific). Timor-Leste is not a Convention 108 party.; Government: Timor Digital 2032 (National Strategic Plan for Digital and ICT Development 2022-2032, approved by Government Resolution 4/2023) read in full in PT and EN from the official timordigital.gov.tl/TIC TIMOR document store: it contains no reference to artificial intelligence, so it is outside scope (no AI pillar). timor-leste.gov.tl searched in PT and EN: only news/communiques (AI dialogue 24 Aug 2026; CM 16 Sep 2026 AI endorsement for ASEAN chairmanship; Digital Transformation Strategy 2026-2036 consultation) – held as leads, no published AI document.; Ministries: Searched, nothing found: no AI strategy, policy or guidance from education, health, justice, defence, finance, labour or interior ministries; Ministry of Transport and Communications' 2026-2036 strategy draft not published.; Regulators: Searched, nothing found: no data protection authority exists; Banco Central de Timor-Leste, National Communications Authority (ANC) and TIC TIMOR cyber-security pages have no AI-specific documents.. Not reached: none. Could not verify: Jornal da República has no full-text search; individual gazette issues were not bulk-searched for 'inteligência artificial'.; tic.gov.tl Strategic Plan page (/en/tic/planu/tic/) reset the connection.. binding-law, strategy, government-governance, ethics, risk-assurance, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, data-privacy, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found. Weekly change check 2026-10-29: government site communiques list read; Council of Ministers meetings of 7, 21 and 28 Oct 2026 listed, no AI item seen in the 21 Oct summary (via search result); the 28 Oct meeting page could not be loaded (proxy tunnel closed). Only the 16 Sep 2026 AI item (already a lead) found. Jornal da Republica not reachable. No new records.

leads.title: Estratégia de Transformação Digital de Timor-Leste 2026–2036 (proposta em consulta pública)
leads.issuing_authority: Ministry of Transport and Communications / TIC TIMOR, I.P.
leads.note: Government news item of April 2026 (https://timor-leste.gov.tl/?p=48530&lang=en) reports a two-day public consultation workshop on the draft; its thematic pillars include a 'regulatory framework for emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence'. No draft or final text found on timor-leste.gov.tl, tic.gov.tl or the timordigital.gov.tl document API on 2026-10-12. Record as strategy (and drafts) once the text is published.

leads.title: Deliberação do Conselho de Ministros de 16 de setembro de 2026 sobre a utilização estratégica de Inteligência Artificial na preparação da Presidência da ASEAN 2029 (projeto-piloto Anunnai)
leads.english_title: Council of Ministers deliberation of 16 September 2026 endorsing the strategic use of AI for the 2029 ASEAN Chairmanship (Anunnai platform pilot)
leads.note: Official communique (https://timor-leste.gov.tl/?p=51782&lang=en) states the Council resolved to endorse the strategic use of AI, knowledge graphs, digital twins and predictive intelligence for ASEAN Chairmanship preparation and authorised a pilot of the Anunnai platform coordinated by ACNOC through the National ASEAN Secretariat. Communique only; no resolution text found in the Jornal da República. Check later gazette issues for a Government Resolution.

leads.title: Government Dialogue on Artificial Intelligence ('Inteligência Artificial para a Construção do Estado e Desenvolvimento Nacional'), 24 August 2026 – outcome / future national AI framework
leads.english_title: Government Dialogue on AI for State-Building and National Development – outcome document and future national AI framework
leads.issuing_authority: Presidency of the Council of Ministers with the Presidency of the Republic
leads.note: Dialogue was announced as input to the Digital Transformation Strategy 2026-2036, priority public-sector AI applications and a future national AI framework. The Prime Minister's opening address (https://timor-leste.gov.tl/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Science-for-Development-Summit-Opening-Address_24Aug25_PT.pdf) is a speech, not an instrument. No outcome document found.
